architecture.title: The model perceives, Jev judges, code decides — one policy for every modality
architecture.caption: Photos, voicemails and CCTV clips go to a multimodal model that writes TEXT. Code pulls exact facts from that text (regex numbers, invoice arithmetic, caller-ID room). Jev makes typed judgments on the text in ~0.5 s. One policy turns every modality into a proposal, alert or human review — execute: False. Jev can also run FIRST as a gatekeeper, deciding from the report text whether the slow perception call is needed at all.

charts.title: Perception vs decision — one call each
charts.caption: Measured by labs/lab01_capability_map.py on 2026-09-27, single observations. Across all runs Jev took 0.4–0.7 s; perception 1.2–5 s in the cloud, ~12 s for local gemma4 on a cold start, and one TTS call once took over 2 minutes.
